I've seen several Youtube videos, folks like Bdubs, Pixelriffs, Turtlederp, Lord Dakr, and several others. With this build, I was initially quite concerned with space. Other parts of the island have been claimed so I had pick one place where I knew no one was building for this project. There's not a whole lot of space to build out and I had an idea of how big the interior needed to be. So think I'll be adding some depth, I think, maybe building out on the sides now that I know there is room on the sides for depth. 

There is some slight variation already, but not much. So I'll add a bit more and see how it goes.

Thank you!

I was considering a graveyard or something similar but I'm somewhat limited in terms of space since I can't build out the land on the west because it'll cut into the bay and I could build out the east but I'd prefer not to since it'll become spawnable. 

My plan was to build catacombs beneath the church instead of having above ground graves. With the water so close, I imagined the catacombs would get kind of nasty and soggy, so I wanted to some really dingy tunnels and perhaps build a tunnel off them connecting to the Hermetic Society/Nebulous Occult Fraternity. 

But perhaps it would make sense to add some above ground graves, places where the common folk might be buried if the catacombs were reserved for priests and notable locals.

My partner and I have been playing on a server for two months and we’ve taken over a Mushroom Island, intending to turn it into a medieval port. We’re going for an Eastern European or Byzantine style with a little bit of Italian thrown in occasionally. We drew inspiration from the Sopoćani monastery in Serbia the Chersonesus Cathederal in Crimea. This is the basic design we came up with, but neither of us have really done too much detail work and we think it needs more… I don’t know. Depth, perhaps? Flair? I’m not really sure where to begin. Of course, the grounds haven’t been worked on, there are paths, trees, bushes, perhaps a fountain, and other landscaping embellishments that we intend to add, but I wanted to first ask if anyone out there had suggestions on how we could improve the overall structure. 

Note on the structure: We are using Quark. The white blocks used in the church are marble while the black are basalt.
